newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African NBS Boland renews cautionary statement.
newsitem.headline: S.African NBS Boland renews cautionary statement.

text.p: South Africa's NBS Boland Ltd on Sunday renewed a cautionary announcement, saying there would be clarity within about six weeks on talks with Samgro Investment Holdings Ltd, BOE Natwest Ltd and Pepgro.
Samgro and BOE made a standby offer to NBS Boland minority shareholders on June 2, but the NBS Boland price did not fall below the offer price and no deals were closed.
"Within the next six weeks, more information should be available in relation to the ongoing discussions," NBS Boland said in a statement issued on Sunday.

Samgro and Boland Bank shares have been suspended since the merger of NBS and Boland pending a restucturing of the group and NBS Boland shares have climbed amid speculation on the future of the new banking group, Boland and BOE.
